summary: Remove the Bitbucket SDK and its unfixed deepmerge dependency while preserving the Bitbucket Cloud provider API.
userImpact: Bitbucket repository, branch, file, commit and tag operations retain their provider interface.
Bitbucket multipart uploads use the supplied provider credential directly.

instructions: Upgrade to qualified release images or refresh the corresponding published host packages.

security: Remove production deepmerge 4.3.1 rather than suppress CVE-2026-93753. All-severity scanner gates and ignore policy remain unchanged.
knownLimitations: Protected database, real-engine browser and exact-image security candidate gates remain required before publication.
rollback: Prefer a qualified forward release; rolling back restores the vulnerable deepmerge dependency.
validation: Native-fetch HTTP contracts cover the Bitbucket provider operations and real loopback JSON/multipart transfer, authentication, redirect refusal and sanitized errors.
Backend units, typecheck, compiled package-consumer checks and release/package/license/documentation guards pass locally.

Native ARM64 application and frozen-bootstrap images have no unignored findings under the unchanged all-severity scanner policy. Real PostgreSQL bootstrap, idempotence, drift rejection and compiled historical upgrades pass.
Protected exact-candidate cross-architecture, physical database and real-engine browser checks remain publication gates.

customerDocumentation.reason: The dependency replacement preserves the existing Bitbucket operations and requires no configuration change.
